changelog:
Add optional per-user blackout and color-change thresholds with global inheritance
Capture the complete effective color policy at playback startup for consistent session behavior
Report active color boost, gains, saturation, hue, output, blackout, and packet-change diagnostics
Restore saved light state even when the global sync toggle changes during an active session
Add regression coverage for threshold resolution, validation, persistence, status/API wiring, and session capture
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
